vocabulary.definition: yearned to possess or have something desirable
vocabulary.example: She coveted her neighbor's new car.

vocabulary.definition: payments made periodically by one state or ruler to another, especially as a sign of dependence
vocabulary.example: The conquered tribe had to pay tributes to the victorious warriors.

vocabulary.definition: to pacify or placate someone by acceding to their demands
vocabulary.example: The government tried to appease the protesters by offering concessions.

vocabulary.definition: intruding gradually or stealthily on someone's territory or rights
vocabulary.example: The city was encroaching on the nearby wildlife sanctuary.

vocabulary.definition: drastically reduce the strength or effectiveness of something
vocabulary.example: The virus decimated the population of the village.

vocabulary.definition: specific areas of land managed by a Native American tribe under the US Bureau of Indian Affairs
vocabulary.example: The tribe was relocated to a reservation by the government.
